title: Writer's Toolkit — What Is the Effect of Repetition?
skills: identify repetition in literary and rhetorical texts
analyze how repetition creates emphasis and rhythm
explain how repeated words or phrases influence tone and meaning
evaluate the effectiveness of repetition as an author's craft choice
alignment_note: Explains repetition as a deliberate literary and rhetorical technique used to create emphasis, reinforce ideas, shape rhythm, and influence audience response. Supports close reading, rhetorical analysis, poetry analysis, and author's craft study across high school English courses.
